run_bench_fsdp_vit: run the FSDP ViT benchmark with configurable batch size, output path, and GPU count
create_bench_config: create a BenchConfig dataclass with output path, memory tracking, profiler, batch size, and AMP settings
build_dino_pretraining_config: build a DINO pretraining Hydra config with FSDP and mixed precision options for vision transformer
trace_memory_usage: trace layerwise memory usage of an FSDP-wrapped model and save memory tracking plots and JSON traces
profile_forward_backward: profile a single forward-backward pass of an FSDP ViT model using PyTorch CUDA runtime profiler
